description.value: The Hooded Merganser is a lakeside fine-dining restaurant set directly on Okanagan Lake in Penticton, noted for its visionary architecture designed to complement the natural surroundings. The menu is upscale and ingredient-driven, drawing on produce from Valley View Farm and offering dishes like Bouillabaisse, Grilled Lamb Chops, and a range of house-made pastas. For a touring cyclist finishing a day on the Kettle Valley Rail Trail or the Okanagan wine routes, it would make a memorable lakefront dinner destination.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at hoodedmerganser.ca confirmed the business is open and operating as a lakeside dinner restaurant at 21 Lakeshore Drive, Penticton. Phone (250-487-4663) and full address were sourced from the website since OSM tags contained neither. The menu includes multiple clearly vegetarian dishes (Hummus & Tzatziki, Hood Fries, Fried Halloumi, Mushroom Cannelloni, Linguine Alfredo, etc.); no cyclist-specific amenities such as bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or water refill are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM record is missing phone and address; both were sourced from the website and added to the top-level fields.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operational lakeside restaurant in Penticton with an active website, current menus, and ongoing promotions. A legitimate dining stop for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists multiple vegetarian dishes: Hummus & Tzatziki, Italian Goat Cheese Dip, Hood Fries, Fried Halloumi, Focaccia Bites, House Salad, Roasted Beet Salad, Mushroom Cannelloni, Linguine Alfredo

wow_evidence: lakeside fine-dining restaurant set directly on Okanagan Lake... visionary architecture... drawing on produce from Valley View Farm

price.label: Upscale
price.signal: Most entrees $26–34 (braised chuck, bouillabaisse, pasta); steaks $56–62
